ns2:section.sectionText: A prerequisite of ACCY 312 or ACCY 505, or concurrent enrollment. Tax in Action – allows you to prepare tax returns for actual clients through the VITA program. Students are required to log in and use Compass2g (compass2g.illinois.edu) in order to complete this course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Accountancy or Accountancy major(s). Restricted to students with Junior, Senior, or Graduate class standing.
